# MyOpenEdge

> MyOpenEdge is a quant analysis platform for futures and index traders. It decodes Initial Balance (IB) breakouts, momentum candle continuation, OCC, gap fill, inside bar, and outside day patterns from real-time market data to surface statistical trading edges.

## Pages

- [Landing](/): Overview of MyOpenEdge, features, and pricing.
- [Auth](/auth): Sign up or sign in with email/password or Google.
- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Main Edge Lab with IB, MCC, and OCC analysis.
- [Chart](/chart): TradingView-powered price chart with MCC momentum overlay.
- [Watchlist](/watchlist): Real-time ticker tracking.
- [Journal](/journal): Trading journal with Tradovate import and performance scoring.
- [Algos](/algos): EA command center protected by 4-digit PIN.
- [What's In Play](/whats-in-play): IB extension reach probabilities and combo builder.
- [Forecast](/forecast): AI-powered price direction predictions.
- [AI Assistant](/ai-assistant): Chat assistant for trading insights (Indonesian).
- [Docs](/docs): Documentation for analysis methodologies.
- [Upgrade](/upgrade): Pro subscription via NOWPayments (crypto/fiat, IDR/USD).
- [Terms & Conditions](/terms): Legal terms, privacy, and refund policy.
